Third-party components used for the optional neural voice (js/piper.js, js/piper-worker.js).

ort.wasm.min.js, ort-wasm-simd.wasm: onnxruntime-web 1.18.0 (Microsoft), MIT License, https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime
piper_phonemize.js/.wasm/.data: @diffusionstudio/piper-wasm 1.0.0, MIT License (WebAssembly build of piper-phonemize, https://github.com/rhasspy/piper-phonemize).
  It contains espeak-ng (GPL-3.0-or-later, https://github.com/espeak-ng/espeak-ng) and its data files. Source code of espeak-ng is available at that address.

Voice models are downloaded by the user on demand from https://huggingface.co/diffusionstudio/piper-voices (Piper, MIT):
  ru_RU denis, dmitri: dataset CC0 (NabuCasa voice-datasets)
  kk_KZ issai, raya: dataset CC BY 4.0 (IS2AI Kazakh TTS, https://github.com/IS2AI/Kazakh_TTS)
  en_US hfc_female, hfc_male: dataset Hi-Fi Captain, NICT, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial use only)
